description: An over-TTL evidence artifact is REPORTED for archive (ttl.action=archive), NOT deleted in-gate. It is still fully accounted (owner + resolving justification + reachability + ttl_class), so the gate emits ZERO violations — auto-archive is report -> git mv -> _archive/, second-verifier-gated, never an in-gate rm or RED. Being archive-eligible is a verdict signal, not a violation.
